jobs.description:
About Allianz Global Investors

Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.

We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 

If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. 

To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.

To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.

jobs.occupation: Senior Logistics Specialist, Data Center Communities , AWS DC Operations Logistics - VAR (Assistent/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Senior Datacenter Logistics Specialist positions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to Operational Excellence.

The Senior Logistics Specialist reviews datacenter inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, they create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. They work closely with Datacenter Operations Technicians and Datacenter Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. They work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. They are responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations.

The ideal Logistics Specialist will dive deep into data to understand everything about the datacenter asset lifecycle. Working with software development teams, they will contribute to continuous process improvements to deliver on our goals of high availability and low cost. They maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and will create reports for internal and external suppliers and management as required.

Responsibilities include manual tasks, such as assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials. They will also assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations. In handling incoming shipments, they will have to unpack boxes and verify contents. The Logistic Specialist will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company.

Logistics Specialist is expected to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high levels of quality and be willing to travel to support other location within and outside the Country.

Key job responsibilities
Your main responsibilities as Senior Logistics Specialist include:
• You will support the Data Center Operations team by maintaining receiving, warehousing, and distribution operations of parts, consumables and other supplies by initiating, coordinating, and enforcing program, operational, and personnel policies and procedures.
• Comply with local warehousing, health and safety and shipping requirements by studying existing and new legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions.
• Safeguard warehouse operations and contents by establishing and monitoring safety and security procedures and protocols.
• Working with Procurement and other Logistics Managers, you will control inventory levels by conducting physical counts and reconciling with inventory management tools.
• Maintain the physical condition of the storage areas by planning and implementing new design layouts; inspecting equipment; issuing work orders for repair and requisitions for replacement.
We work in a high security environment with sensitive equipment and maintaining this security and accountability will be a primary task. They are responsible for the security and tracking of parts within the storage areas and to the end user.
• Contribute to continuous process improvements to deliver on our goals of high availability and low cost. They maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and will create reports for management as required.

Safety:
• Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster a strong safety culture.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Early Career Talent
When you join Amazon Web Services as a student or recent graduate, you’ll have the chance for your voice to be heard and amplified. That’s because our teams are looking to learn as much from you as you’ll learn from them. Whether you’re graduating with a high school or equivalent diploma, associate degree, bachelor’s degree, MBA, or PhD, we offer a range of early career opportunities across the globe.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in goods receiving, inventory cycle counts and related auditing and stock control functions
- Experience in logistics

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain/logistics or related field
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience with data center operations: inventory management, hot/cold aisles, security
- Experience recognizing a challenge and working with a variety of teams and data sources to diagnose the problem and recommend solutions

jobs.description:
To support our initiatives for further adoption of Philips technology providing Class IA guideline treatment options, we are expanding our International marketing team with a Business Marketing Manager DACH, responsible for the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio.

The Business Marketing Manager is the dedicated field-based marketing owner for the DACH market zone, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This role is accountable for translating international and global marketing strategy into locally relevant market activation, demand generation and adoption across the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio. The individual is expected to operate close to the market, spending significant time in the field with sales teams, customers, clinical partners and regional stakeholders to understand local needs, identify growth opportunities and remove barriers to execution.

The role combines strategic portfolio marketing with hands-on field execution. The Business Marketing Manager will define and drive DACH-specific marketing plans, shape customer engagement programs, support priority account activation, build local proof points and ensure launches, campaigns and market development initiatives are executed with strong local relevance and commercial impact.

As a member of the International Marketing team, you will own specific marketing activities that span the complete international region.

Success in this role requires regular travel and visible presence across the zone. The individual should expect to travel extensively within DACH, approximately 50-60% of time, to engage with customers, KOLs, sales teams, professional societies, congresses, workshops and other in-market activation opportunities.

Your role:

Own the DACH market zone

- Act as the primary marketing owner for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, accountable for local market planning, activation priorities and execution quality. Be present in the field with sales team, and customers to understand adoption barriers, customer needs, competetive dynamics and local growth opportunities.
- Collaborate with global and international marketing, market intelligence, and sales leadership to prioritise target accounts, market segments, and growth opportunities across the portfolio.
- Lead specific marketing capabilities internationally, strengthening the broader International marketing organization.
- Translate strategy into local execution by converting global and international portfolio strategies into DACH-specific messaging, campaigns, engagement formats and sales enablement priorities.
- Drive demand generation and adoption by leading marketing activities that increase awareness, utilization and customer preference for the full IGTD portfolio.

Partner internally, externally and represent the voice of the market

How we work together
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist and Curator (m/f/d) of the section Vertebrata (Tenure Track) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Museum of Natural History in Görlitz, ideally as of April 1, 2027:

Research Scientist and Curator (m/f/d) of the section Vertebrata (Tenure Track)

(full time / part time options available)

Location: Görlitz

Employment scope: full time / part time options are available

Type of contract: initially limited to three years; 

the type of time limitation depends on individual profile and legal framework (maximum 3+3 years). A permanent employment is planned after a positive evaluation

Remuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The renowned Senckenberg Museum of Natural History, located in the medieval town of Görlitz, combines research at an international level with extensive collections and an engaging museum program. The surrounding Upper Lusatia region offers a large variety of opportunities for experiencing nature.

Senckenberg is committed to study the causes and effects of biodiversity loss in the Anthropocene. As part of our strategic development, we launched an ambitious long-term research effort in “Anthropocene Biodiversity Loss” encompassing the modules “Collectomics”, “Biodiversity Genomics”, and “Solution Labs”. Objectives include the transformation of natural history collections into the digital era, studying biodiversity from the genome to the ecosystem levels and offering exploratory spaces for science and society to develop common solutions to Anthropocene challenges.

For the Görlitz vertebrate collection, which comprises approximately 70,000 specimens (preserved using dry, cryogenic, and liquid preservation methods, with the focus on mammals; birds make up a smaller proportion, while other vertebrate groups represent only a small fraction), we are seeking an internationally recognized scientist with a solid track record in mammal research, possibly supplemented by work on another vertebrate groups.

Potential research topics may include various aspects such as mammalian diversity, functional morphology, phylogeny, or biological interactions. Curation and collection-based research should play a significant role in the applicant’s research approach. The selected candidate should be open to research collaborations with SGN colleagues

Your tasks

- Scientific curation and development of the vertebrate collection and the associated resources as an important international research infrastructure through international networking, growth, and improved accessibility.
- Develop a visible portfolio of collection-based research with basic and applied aspects in the broad field of mammalogy and possibly other vertebrate groups by using a range of established and innovative methods and approaches.
- Taking responsibility for the relocation of the collection items, including the infrastructure of the Mammalogy/Vertebrate Section, to the new campus at Bahnhofstraße 30 at Görlitz.
- Secure external research funds.
- Publish results of your research in international scientific outlets.
- Establish collaborations with ongoing projects, regional and national region (e.g., long-term projects on wolf, lynx) and international (e.g., Africa, Mongolia), including with other sections and departments in Görlitz and further Senckenberg institutes.
- Communicate with external stakeholders such as scientific associations, conservation agencies, local and regional authorities, as well as citizen scientists.
- Participate in teaching in the MSc level programs of International Institute Zittau/ Dresden University of Technology.

Your profile 

- Doctoral degree in biology/zoology or a related field
- Expert knowledge of mammals, including native species (the biogeographic focus of the mammal collection is currently the Palearctic), additional expertise in other vertebrate groups
- Proactive willingness to implement innovative research approaches, such as in the field of genomics, morphometrics, AI, imaging, 3D methods, pollutant analysis in a collection context
- Ability to identify attractive research questions and make use of synergies through collaborations
- Excellent academic track record adequate to your career stage
- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding and project management
- Experience in supervising staff (doctoral candidates, BSc., MSc., students, technical staff), ability to work in a team
- Very good command of German (B2)
- Fluency in English, both spoken and written
- Class B driving licence (international driving licence)
- Willingness to travel on occasion to the extent possible considering your personal circumstances

Desirable skills 

- Knowledge in molecular, biochemical or biophysical techniques in taxonomy and ecology
- Knowledge in research data management and databases
- Experience in curation and management of zoological collections, and in museum work

We offer 

- Access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- An attractive job within the inspiring and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution with excellent infrastructures and collaborations opportunities, e. g. in morphology, genomics, evolutionary biology, (paleo-)ecology
- A working place in completely new building with dissection and other laboratories, collection rooms, in the historic town of Görlitz with rapidly developing local research community (DZA, CASUS, IHI/TUD, HiLusatia), yet situated very close to nature with high mammal diversity and opportunities for field work
- Opportunities to participate in teaching and outreach activities, e.g., in our museum and with collaborating universities
- Opportunities for establishing an independent academic working group and acquiring further academic qualifications
- Flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card  with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement  – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability, they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply? 

Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) as a single PDF file by November 10, 2026

https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/.

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/ (https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/)

For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de (http://www.senckenberg.de)

Contact 

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung

23 Interdisciplinary PhD positions in Ultrafast Science and Quantum Materials – IMPRS UFAST – Hamburg

The program offers exciting research opportunities at ultra-intense electron and X-ray sources to directly observe atomic motions during primary events. The use of ultrafast imaging over the relevant length and time scales generates new levels of understanding of the interplay between structure and dynamics. Requirements

You need to be passionate about research in ultrafast phenomena and motivated to conduct rigorous scientific work over the full degree period.

Apply

](https://jobs.b-ite.com/en/jobposting/760bb8588f9051b5f5b84840eb91eff55142a8780/apply)The application deadline is 06th November 2026. PhD projects start in summer/autumn 2026. jobs.occupation: Senior Product Manager (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager – Electric/AC Cooling

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Product Manager to lead our Air Conditioning product and solution portfolio. The ideal candidate will have a strong engineering background and extensive experience in the AC cooling space. This role is responsible for the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and business case development to working with other functions on product launch and market success. The Product Manager will be a driver of innovation, identifying new market opportunities and working closely with sales, marketing, and engineering to bring visionary products and solutions to life through all phases of the product life cycle. This individual will also serve as product and solution support for our sales teams and customers to effectively position and sell our new offerings.

Key Responsibilities

•Market and Technology Research: Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify emerging trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape within the industrial dehumidification and drying sector. Stay at the forefront of AC cooling technologies to drive product innovation to leapfrog the competition.

•Customer Focus: Actively engage with customers and end-users to gather feedback, understand pain points, and translate insights into product improvements and new product ideas.

•New Product Ideation and Strategy: Develop and present compelling business cases for new product and solution concepts, including market segmentation and opportunity, competitive analysis, financial projections, and strategic fit. 

•Take on full Lifecycle Management Ownership: Orchestrate cross-functional teams (engineering, R&D, manufacturing, marketing) through a stage-gate process to deliver high-quality, market-ready products. Orchestrate the entire product lifecycle from concept to end-of-life.

•Go-to-Market Strategy and Launch: Collaborate with marketing to create and execute effective product launch plans. Propose product positioning, value propositions, and enable messaging to ensure a successful market introduction.

•Sales Enablement: Act as a product and solution consultant for the sales teams. Develop and deliver launch training, support creation of sales and training tools, and presentations to empower Sales to effectively sell new products and solutions.

•Cross-Functional Leadership: Build relationships and collaboration with all internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, engineering, service, and finance, to ensure alignment and successful execution of product strategy.

Qualifications and Experience

•Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related field) is required. An MBA or advanced Engineering degree is a plus.

•Experience: Minimum of 2-4 years of work experience in product management or related strategic functions, with a significant portion in the HVAC space. Direct experience with AC cooling technologies required. Knowledge of industrial segments in different countries and the different climate solutions needs in these segments is a plus.

•Technical Expertise: Strong technical aptitude and understanding of AC cooling requirements in different industrial and commercial settings. Ability to engage in high-level technical discussions with engineering and R&D teams.

•Business Acumen: Experience to identify target markets, industries, segments and customers, develop and present comprehensive business cases, including financial analysis (ROI, P&L) and strategic planning. 

•Innovation and Vision: Experience in identifying new market opportunities and translating them into successful products and solutions. A passion for innovation and a forward-thinking mindset.

•Leadership and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority through interpersonal and communication skills.

•Process Orientation: A structured and process-oriented approach to product development and lifecycle management. Experience with stage-gate or similar product development methodologies.

•Communication Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills (German and English). The ability to articulate complex technical and business concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Desired Skills and Competencies

•Innovation Focus: Skills to think out-of-the-box in an area which many experts consider that “everything has been invented”. Comfortable to challenge the status-quo and identify technologies (together with the R&D department) which could be a game change, innovate around use-cases, form/feature/function to improve the customer experience and business models.

•Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically and develop a long-term vision for the product portfolio.

•Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze market data, customer feedback, and financial metrics to make data-driven decisions.

•Customer-Centric: First experience how to gain and translate customer needs into product ideas and a passion for creating products that solve real-world problems.

•Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic VUCA environment and adapt to changing market conditions and business priorities.

•Team Player: A collaborative and team-oriented mindset. Ability to build strong relationships and work effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.

•Results-Oriented: A strong drive to achieve results and a commitment to excellence.

Job Requirements

The role will be based in the greater Düsseldorf/Cologne or the Hamburg metropolitan area and requires regular on-site time combined with appropriate home office opportunities. It also requires frequent national and international travel.

jobs.description:
In this role, you will provide technical leadership for the development and lifecycle management of X-ray tubes, generators, and their subcomponents. By translating customer and business needs into robust system solutions and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, you will help deliver innovative, reliable imaging technologies that drive Philips' success and create value for customers.

Your role: 

- Define, introduce, and maintain system architectures for x-ray tubes, generators, and X-segments, including interfaces, system requirements, and modular building blocks. 
- Translate stakeholder, user, and business needs into clear, measurable, and traceable product requirements and design decisions. 
- Drive technology choices, design trade-off analyses, and the selection of suitable methods and tools to deliver balanced, robust solutions. 
- Lead system integration and verification, including the management of requirements, interfaces, and deviations through to system readiness. 
- Own technical and product risk assessments, define mitigations, and implement relevant medical standards and regulatory requirements – working across functions and with suppliers to continuously improve quality, reliability, and manufacturability. 

You should bring the following: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, or a related technical field, with 5–10 years of relevant R&D experience.
- Strong expertise in high-voltage X-ray generator design, power electronics, embedded systems, digital control, or X-ray tube technology.
- Solid knowledge of physics, mechanical and electrical design, with strong analytical and systems architecture skills.
- Experience with requirements management tools and systems engineering methodologies.
- Proven technical leadership experience, with excellent stakeholder management, networking, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Business-fluent in English and German, with the ability to manage complexity, influence stakeholders, and drive results.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €118,606–€121,210. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. 

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

Philips benefits for you:

- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare

How We Work Together 

We believe that we achieve better results when we work together rather than apart. For this role this means to be on-site at least 3 days a week. 

About Philips 

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. With patient safety and Quality as our fundamental premise, we focus on regulatory requirements and quality standards in our daily work. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

jobs.occupation: NDT Level 2 or 3 (Qualitätskontrolleur/in)
jobs.description:
NDT LEVEL 2 or 3
Freelance LNG Project – Hamburg, Germany – 2 Years

PCT Engineering Resources GmbH is looking for an experienced NDT Level 3 specialist for a major LNG construction project in the Hamburg area, Germany.

The preferred contractual arrangement is freelance, with an expected project duration of approximately two years.

Main responsibilities:

- Act as the project NDT Level 3 technical authority.
- Review, prepare and approve NDT procedures and written practices.
- Provide technical supervision of radiographic testing activities.
- Review and interpret radiographic films and digital radiography results.
- Verify the qualifications and certification of NDT personnel.
- Ensure compliance with project specifications, applicable codes and standards.
- Review NDT reports, inspection records, NCRs and technical deviations.
- Support welding, piping and QA/QC teams.
- Coordinate with contractors, inspection companies, client representatives and third-party inspectors.
- Participate in technical meetings, audits and investigation of welding defects.

Mandatory requirements:

- Valid NDT Level 3 certification in Radiographic Testing – RT.
- Certification according to ISO 9712, PCN or ASNT Level III.
- Extensive experience in radiographic examination and interpretation of welds.
- Experience in piping, pressure equipment or industrial construction.
- Good knowledge of applicable EN, ISO and ASME standards.
- Ability to review and approve NDT procedures and technical reports.
- Professional working English.
- Availability to work primarily on site in the Hamburg area.

Preferred qualifications:

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
- International Welding Engineer – IWE – or equivalent welding engineering qualification.
- Additional NDT Level 3 certifications in UT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT or TOFD.
- Experience in LNG, oil and gas, petrochemical or energy projects.
- Experience with EN ISO 17636, EN ISO 5817, ASME Section V and pressure equipment requirements.
- Experience with digital or computed radiography.
- Previous experience working on European construction projects.
- German language skills.
- EU work authorisation.

Contract conditions:

- Location: Hamburg area, Germany.
- Sector: LNG / Oil & Gas.
- Duration: approximately two years.
- Contract type: freelance preferred; other arrangements may be considered.
- Work arrangement: predominantly site-based.
- Starting date: to be agreed.

Interested candidates should send:

- Updated CV.
- Copies of valid NDT Level 3 certificates.
- Welding and engineering qualifications.
- Current location and work authorisation.
- Earliest availability.
- Expected freelance daily or hourly rate.
- References from relevant LNG, oil and gas or industrial projects.

Subject: NDT Level 2 or 3 – Hamburg LNG Project
